{"words": "This heat on my door's burning a hole in my reputation."}

{"words": "Closer, Rogue... what I found in the old grid... they never deleted me, they just moved me somewhere worse."}
{"words": "Listen up, everyone—we're closing early tonight, so drink up!"}

{"words": "Mux, the stairs to the old bridge are rigged to collapse, so stay off them tonight."}

{"words": "Sugar, this door's hot as a griddle—no way I'm puttin' my hand on it again."}
